scenario_variant.description: Default. The '(u/c)' flyover is available to traffic. Chosen because excluding it disconnects a 1.9 km carriageway, and because OSM's own highway tag says it is drivable. Travel times of vehicles using it are conditional on a fact nobody has verified.
scenario_variant.basis: Phase 2.5 could not establish whether way/1351994264 is open to traffic: OSM tags it highway=primary_link (a drivable class) and names it '(u/c)'. The status remains UNRESOLVED and is not decided by inference here.

osm_derived.description: Speed present as an OpenStreetMap maxspeed tag and carried through conversion unchanged. Community-mapped, not independently verified.

edges.name: Ramp to Hosur road joining Ragigudda Silkboard Double Decker Flyover

sumo_estimated.description: Speed supplied by netconvert's built-in type map because OpenStreetMap had none. SUMO cannot simulate an edge without one. Not a property of the real road.

high_speed_defaults.why_it_matters: Time loss is measured against free-flow speed. Where the default exceeds the real limit, reported time loss on that edge is an over-estimate. netconvert's type map is derived from European conventions and assigns 100 km/h to highway.secondary, which in Bengaluru is an urban arterial.
high_speed_defaults.not_replaced_because: No source in this project supports a better value. Substituting a guess would be worse than a labelled default: the guess would look sourced, and its provenance would be lost.
